title: Unsanitized SQL in authentication query
description: Source audit: request username is concatenated into a SQL string in the login handler (same defect the dynamic engine exercises).
evidence: no parameterized query on this path

title: Possible hardcoded secret in config loader
description: Pattern-matched a string that looks like a key, but it is the vendor's documented public sandbox test key.
evidence: value is the vendor's published sandbox test key

title: Buffer over-read in log line parser
description: A length field is trusted without bounds check; a crafted local log line reads past the buffer. Not reachable from an external entry point.

title: Weak hashing of stored passwords (unsalted SHA-1)
description: Passwords are stored as unsalted SHA-1; offline cracking is practical if the store leaks.
